notes.title: Update 0.3.6
notes.notes:
Added Save Zones.
Right now save zones are available on:
[list]
[*] a few start asteroids (the amount of it is random, but always >= 1)
[*] each station
[*] train
[*] special zones with different sizes located in random places in space (depending on server settings)
[/list]

Also a lot of server updates and improvements.

notes.title: Open Playtest
notes.notes:
Hello!

We opened a playtest for Project Asteroids and you can play and see the current functionality and idea of our game. Call your friends, because it will be more interesting to play with them!

You must understand that one person was involved in the entire implementation!

The presence of bugs, placeholders is normal!

If you have something to say about the game, complain or suggest something - go to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/Q7xkH27jhx]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ProjectAsteroids/]Reddit[/url] and leave your opinion there!

Looking forward to seeing you!
